name: Shechem
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: The sons of Jacob answered deceitfully: every male of the city must be circumcised before they would consent. Hamor and Shechem persuaded the whole city, reasoning that the wealth of Jacob's house would become theirs; every male was circumcised.

note.label: Genesis 34: Dinah and the Zeal of Simeon and Levi
